## DeviceAuthorizationState Enum

Describes a device's authorization in the currently known account device state\.

```csharp
public enum DeviceAuthorizationState
```
### Fields

<a name='Meshline.Components.DeviceAuthorizationState.Unknown'></a>

`Unknown` 0

No account device state is available for assessment\.

<a name='Meshline.Components.DeviceAuthorizationState.Authorized'></a>

`Authorized` 1

The device is registered and its certificate is currently valid\.

<a name='Meshline.Components.DeviceAuthorizationState.NotRegistered'></a>

`NotRegistered` 2

The device is absent from the known account device state\.

<a name='Meshline.Components.DeviceAuthorizationState.NotYetValid'></a>

`NotYetValid` 3

The registered certificate's validity period has not begun\.

<a name='Meshline.Components.DeviceAuthorizationState.Expired'></a>

`Expired` 4

The registered certificate has expired\.
